instruction: Describe the steps to set VLC's maximum volume to 200% instead of the default 125%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC maximum volume setting from default 125% to 200%. The evaluator checks vlcrc configuration file to verify qt-max-volume=200. Uses existing metric check_qt_max_volume from VLC evaluators. Similar complexity to original task - both require navigating VLC preferences and changing a single configuration value.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: VLC max volume set to 200%
Getter (get_vlc_config) extracts the correct state: reads VLC configuration file (vlcrc) where qt-max-volume setting is stored
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) implements correct comparison logic: searches for 'qt-max-volume=' line and compares value to expected '200'
Expected value is semantically correct: '200' matches the instruction requirement to increase max volume to 200%
Proper parameter handling: metric correctly accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] (framework passes rules dict directly when expected.type='rule')
Postconfig is appropriate: kills and relaunches VLC to ensure configuration changes are persisted to disk before verification
Edge cases handled: default value (125), type conversion (int to string), file not found errors
Complete coverage: single requirement (qt-max-volume=200) is fully verified
